avd-second-brain

Personal project. Research and learning only. Not for production. No warranty.
  • Built on my own time for research and learning. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by my employer, Liquidware or Microsoft.
  • Don't run any of it in production or against tenants that matter. Test in a dedicated lab subscription and tenant first.
  • Provided "as is", without warranty of any kind, under each repo's license. You use it at your own risk and own the Azure charges it incurs.
  • Contributions and forks are welcome and encouraged. See Contribute.

On top: the why, over the environment's life. One memory across the AVD lifecycle: what each estate looked like, what broke, what was learned, and why each rule is what it is.

The repo is the source of truth: nickprignano/avd-second-brain. This page says where it fits.

What it does

  • A knowledge base of generalized facts: app catalog, rules with their history, sizing calibration and shared runbooks.
  • Estate vaults keep one customer's estate in that customer's own private repo. Tenant data never comes back here.
  • The contract registry and fact register that every repo boundary uses.
  • A docs consistency check and a generated handbook that agents search.

How it fits

  • Thinks for avd-swarm, which acts; the brain never holds a write credential.
  • Reads facts from avd-current-state and lessons from avd-landing-zone.
